hook: What stops a model change from degrading quality for every user at once?
bullets: Rollback thresholds are set before any traffic moves
The release widens from 5% to 25% to 50% as metrics pass
A 2.6-point accuracy drop at 50% breaches the limit
The gate reverts all traffic automatically and pages on-call
